PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio
Business & Pricing Information for explaining charges, memberships, renewals, payment plans, cancellations, and services.
PeakFit is a premium fitness center offering gym memberships, personal training, group classes, transformation programs,
and wellness packages. Customers may pay upfront, monthly, or through approved installments. The assistant explains
charges, renewals, plans, cancellations, and services in simple language.
1. Membership Plans
Starter - Rs. 1,999/month or Rs. 19,999/year. Unlimited gym access; standard equipment; locker access; basic fitness
assessment; one trainer orientation session.
Pro Fitness - Rs. 3,499/month or Rs. 34,999/year. Unlimited gym access and group classes; monthly fitness assessment; 2
trainer-guided sessions/month; locker access; basic nutrition guidance.
Elite - Rs. 5,999/month or Rs. 59,999/year. Unlimited gym and group classes; 4 PT sessions/month; monthly body
composition assessment; personalized workout plan; basic nutrition consultation; priority booking.
Billing: monthly plans bill at the listed monthly price; annual plans follow the selected plan and payment method. Savings vs
12 monthly payments: Starter Rs. 3,989; Pro Rs. 6,989; Elite Rs. 11,988.
PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio Page 2 of 6
2. Personal Training & Transformation
PT Starter - Rs. 7,999 for 5 sessions/45 days (about Rs. 1,600/session); normally upfront.
PT Plus - Rs. 14,499 for 10 sessions/90 days (about Rs. 1,450/session); trainer availability applies.
PT Pro - Rs. 26,999 for 20 sessions/180 days (about Rs. 1,350/session); most economical PT package.
30-Day Transformation - Rs. 8,999 upfront: initial assessment, personalized workout plan, 4 trainer sessions, weekly
tracking, basic nutrition plan, final assessment.
90-Day Transformation - Rs. 22,999 upfront or approved installment: initial assessment, personalized workout, 12 PT
sessions, weekly tracking, nutrition guidance, monthly body composition assessment, final assessment. Approved 3-month
example: about Rs. 7,667/month. Approximate session rates are calculations only and do not change package price or
validity.
PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio Page 3 of 6
3. Payment Plans & Promotions
Installments apply only to selected higher-value plans. Show only the approved case plan.
3-Month Split: eligible purchases above Rs. 15,000. Example Rs. 22,999: Rs. 7,667 first, then Rs. 7,666 and Rs. 7,666; later
payments about every 30 days.
6-Month Split: eligible purchases above Rs. 30,000. Example Rs. 34,999 annual Pro: Rs. 6,000 first, then about Rs. 5,800
for each of five payments.
Exact amounts must come from the approved case. The assistant must not create a new schedule.
Promotions: New Member Offer gives 20% off the first month only: Starter Rs. 1,599; Pro Rs. 2,799; Elite Rs. 4,799. Annual
offer: Starter Rs. 19,999 vs Rs. 23,988 monthly total; Pro Rs. 34,999 vs Rs. 41,988; Elite Rs. 59,999 vs Rs. 71,988. Referral:
existing customer may receive Rs. 500 PeakFit credit after the referred customer's first successful payment; credit is for
eligible future purchases, not cash. No invented or negotiated discounts.
PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio Page 4 of 6
4. Renewals, Failed Payments & Attendance
Monthly memberships renew automatically unless cancelled under the terms. Example: Pro joined Sept 5 normally renews
around Oct 5. October is the next membership period, not a new purchase. Renewal uses the current applicable monthly
price. A first-month promotion does not continue unless stated.
If an automatic payment fails, the system may send a recovery message and secure payment link. A failed payment does
not necessarily mean cancellation. Explain the failed collection and provide the approved recovery option. Never claim
success unless the case confirms it.
Late cancellation/no-show fees: Group Class - more than 6 hours: no fee; within 6 hours: Rs. 299; no-show: Rs. 499.
Personal Training - more than 12 hours: no fee; within 12 hours: Rs. 499; no-show: Rs. 799. No-show fees are separate
from the underlying session price.
Rescheduling is generally possible with sufficient notice and an available slot. A permitted reschedule normally has no fee.
Late cancellation/no-show fees may still apply afterward. Never promise a trainer or time without confirmed availability.
PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio Page 5 of 6
5. Pause, Cancellation, Refunds & FAQs
Pause: eligible monthly memberships may pause up to 30 days at a time; maximum 2 pauses per 12 months. Overdue
payments are not cancelled by a pause, and a pause does not reverse a collected payment. Exceptions require staff
handling.
Cancellation: monthly memberships can generally be cancelled before the next renewal date under the terms. Cancellation
does not erase an already-due payment. A processed renewal remains tied to that membership period; future renewal
cancellation and outstanding balance are separate.
Refunds: eligibility depends on the product. Unused eligible services may be reviewed under applicable terms. Consumed
PT sessions and completed classes are generally not refundable. Active-period membership payments are not automatically
refunded because attendance stops. Never promise a refund without case approval.
FAQs: Rs. 3,499 usually means the regular monthly Pro plan or its renewal. A repeat charge usually reflects the next billing
cycle, not a duplicate purchase. A reminder may concern another balance, failed renewal, no-show fee, or installment.
Installments exist only when approved for the case. Discounts and fee waivers cannot be invented or promised.
PeakFit Fitness & Wellness Studio Page 6 of 6
6. Recovery Assistant Rules
When a customer opens payment-plan chat, identify the charge or balance first. Explain the product/service, amount,
billing/renewal period, payment status, and any approved payment/installment option. Use plain language.
The assistant must not change limits or pricing, create a new plan, reduce the first payment, override policy, invent/negotiate
discounts, claim an unconfirmed payment succeeded, waive fees, promise refunds, or promise availability without
confirmation.
Decision authority: policy engine and case data control payment decisions, minimum payments, discounts, limits, stopping
rules, and approved actions. This document is informational only; it explains the business, products, charges, and policies
and does not change decisions.
